'''Ith'ril Eventide''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] who lived in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was the leader of the [[Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild]], a group of slavers that operated in the Dantooine system and controlled the system's [[Ith'ril Eventide (space area)|Area D-504]]. When Eventide came into power in the organization, Area D-504 was immediately renamed to Ith'ril Eventide in his honor.<ref name="SWG:IE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ith'ril Eventide was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The mention of Ith'ril Eventide was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IE" />
